column3: The US supreme court has allowed Donald Trump to continue his administration’s construction of a border wall in Texas’s Big Bend region, including parts of Big Bend national park. (美國最高法院已允許唐納·川普繼續其政府在德州大彎曲地區的邊境圍牆建設，其中包括大彎曲國家公園的部分區域。)

In an unsigned, five-page ruling, the nation’s highest court granted the Trump administration’s emergency request to suspend a lower court order that had temporarily stopped the project last month. (在一份未署名的五頁裁決中，國家最高法院批准了川普政府的緊急請求，暫停了上個月暫時停止該項目的下級法院命令。)

Nvidia’s board needs to do some succession planning – sharpish Donald Trump, Elon Musk and prominent finance moguls have expressed their support for embattled Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, as the head of the world’s most valuable chip company faces an internal investigation over a romantic relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. (輝達董事會需要儘快進行接班規劃——唐納·川普、伊隆·馬斯克和著名的金融大亨們已表達了對陷入困境的輝達執行長黃仁勳的支持，因為這位全球最有價值晶片公司的負責人正因與一名疑似中國間諜的戀情而面臨內部調查。)

British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault. (英國喜劇演員羅素·布蘭德因強姦與性侵罪被判處超過 10 年徒刑。)

Russell Brand, who became a celebrity darling in the early 2000s, was found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in a case brought by six women. (羅素·布蘭德在 2000 年代初期成為名人寵兒，他在六名女性提起的案件中，被判一項強姦罪和三項性侵罪成立。)
